title.zh: 获取旁路直播任务布局参数
title.en: Obtain layout parameters of a bypass live streaming job

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateMPULayout](~~162192~~)创建旁路直播布局。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes

Before calling this operation, call [CreateMPULayout](~~162192~~) to create a bypass live streaming layout.

# QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
